subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finservcorp.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Priya / Alex —

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciated the candid discussion about your fraud-detection workflows. Recap + proposed next steps below so we have a single place to track alignment.

Quick demo recap:
- Showed Redwood API integration using the redwood/medium-finserv model for document parsing + reranking; latency profile was ~120ms p50 on our dev cluster.
- Walked through prefix caching and a suggested batching config for your expected 1k qps during peak.
- Discussed private deployment option for production (VPC) and Dedicated for predictable throughput in month 2+.

Proposed 4-week POC (goal: validate model quality & serving economics):
1) Objectives / success criteria (we should agree on these):
   - Precision@50 for flagged cases >= 92% compared to your baseline pipeline
   - Average inference cost per 1k decisions <= $12 (based on test load)
   - End-to-end latency (query -> decision) p95 <= 600ms in test environment
   - Ability to route to a fallback model with <5% error during simulated capacity degradation
   - Integration with your audit/logging pipeline (events captured to S3)

2) Evaluation plan / timeline:
   Week 0 (this week): sign SOW / mutual NDA addendum; exchange AWS account IDs and playground dataset; kickoff call
   Week 1: environment setup (private trial tenant + test keys), ingest sample dataset, baseline runs
   Week 2: evaluation runs (A/B against baseline), latency/cost profiling, begin qualitative review
   Week 3: regression testing, failover simulation, tweak batching/quantization settings
   Week 4: final analysis, handoff review, recommendation + options for Dedicated rollout

3) Ownership:
   - Redwood (Marissa): overall POC coordination, model tuning recommendations, demo/tests
   - FinServ (Priya): technical lead for dataset access, evaluation criteria sign-off, ingestion support
   - Procurement (Alex): contract/SOW and billing review

4) Next steps (asks for you):
   - Confirm that success criteria above look right or suggest edits
   - Confirm preferred kickoff window (proposed Mon 2027-04-05 or Tue 2027-04-06)
   - Share a sample (non-PII) dataset or example payload by EOD Friday 2027-04-02

Attachments: Redwood_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (POC scope + SOW draft), Redwood_Trial_SLA.xlsx (trial SLA + responsibilities)

I can convert the POC scope into a short SOW once you confirm objectives. Happy to hop on a quick 15-min alignment call if helpful.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142
https://redwood.inference

From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and proposed timeline — this looks like a solid plan. A couple of quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Data handling: can you confirm that logs/outputs from the POC will be stored in our S3 and that Redwood will only access them for the duration of the POC? We need this for our internal audit.
2) SLA: the trial SLA spreadsheet references a 99.5% availability target — is that achievable for a private trial tenant, or should we expect lower guarantees until we move to Dedicated?
3) Success criteria: for the precision metric, can you confirm how you recommend measuring it (we use labeled historical alerts; would you like a CSV with labels or sample API-based callbacks?)

We can likely do the kickoff on Tue 2027-04-06 in the morning PT — Alex, does that work for procurement to be available?

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Product Manager, Risk Analytics
priya.desai@finservcorp.com

Hi Priya —

Great questions — answers inline: 

1) Data handling: for the POC we will mount a short-term S3 bucket in your account (you retain full control); Redwood will request a scoped IAM role for read/write limited to the bucket and will remove access at POC end. We will send a short access checklist for your infra team.

2) Trial SLA: for private trial tenants we typically operate at an internal 99% availability SLO (we observe ~99.2% on trial tenants historically) — the 99.5% number in the sheet reflects Dedicated contractual targets. I will update the trial SLA sheet with a callout and expected SLO for private trials.

3) Precision measurement: CSV with labeled historical alerts is ideal — we can run A/B comparisons server-side and provide the evaluation notebook. Please send a CSV with these fields: case_id, text_payload, label_gold (1/0). If you prefer callbacks, we can support that as well.

Kickoff: Tue 2027-04-06 9:30am PT works for our team. I'll book a 45-min kickoff and include a short agenda.

I'm attaching an updated Redwood_POC_Scope_v1.pdf (added the data-access checklist) and a link to a quick checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodPOC

Looping in Dylan for procurement coordination on SOW and billing.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
